imdb_episode:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "doc"."imdb_episode" (
   "show_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
   "imdb_episode_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
   "imdb_show_id" TEXT,
   "season_number" INTEGER,
   "episode_number" INTEGER,
   "name" TEXT,
   "imdb_user_score_original" DOUBLE PRECISION,
   "imdb_user_score_rating_count" INTEGER,
   "created_at" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,
   "updated_at" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,
   PRIMARY KEY ("show_id", "imdb_episode_id")
)
CLUSTERED BY ("show_id") INTO 6 SHARDS
WITH (
   column_policy = 'strict',
   number_of_replicas = '0-1'
)

crawl_priority:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "doc"."crawl_priority" (
   "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
   "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
   "demand" BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
   "acknowledged_demand" BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
   "claimed_demand" BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
   "last_success_at" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,
   "lease_token" TEXT,
   "lease_expires_at" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,
   "created_at" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,
   "updated_at" TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,
   "alias_demand_transfers" OBJECT(DYNAMIC) AS (
      "162483" BIGINT,
      "3635601" BIGINT,
      "5338654" BIGINT
   ),
   PRIMARY KEY ("media_type", "tmdb_id"),
   CONSTRAINT doc_crawl_priority_media_type_check_93d076bff8b4 CHECK("media_type" IN ('movie', 'show'))
)
CLUSTERED INTO 3 SHARDS
WITH (
   column_policy = 'strict',
   number_of_replicas = '0-1'
)
